summary: Don is a 2006 Indian Hindi-language action thriller co-written and directed by Farhan Akhtar. It remakes the 1978 film of the same name. Shah Rukh Khan plays Don, who manages a drug cartel's operations, and Priyanka Chopra plays Roma. After Don is badly hurt in a chase, police send his look-alike, a street performer, to impersonate him and gather intelligence on the drug mafia. Akhtar wrote it with his father, Javed Akhtar, a co-writer of the original. It kept the basic plot but added an international setting and a different climax. Most of it was shot in Malaysia. It opened on 20 October 2006, at Diwali, to generally positive reviews. It grossed ₹106 crore against a ₹40 crore budget, the fifth-highest gross for a Hindi film that year. Its climax was especially well received. A sequel, Don 2, followed in 2011.
